title: Holy Trinity Cathedral, Addis Ababa

terrainReference.basis: Independent original approach grade from the western front of the footprint, near the photo-documented main stair.

mapIdentity.scope: The exact mapped 12-corner standing cathedral exterior, near-straight 26.46 m west front and eastern sanctuary projection, with approximate component sections from the three verified archived cathedral views.

note: One original Terrarium source tile fixes the western approach and site relief. The complete western archive view controls the seven-arched portico, the stepped stone gables, two bulbous finials and the main entry stairs. Nave, sanctuary and rear sections are approximate.
